_comment: A worked findings.json, for the DES-9999 Rev 1 -> Rev 2 fixture pair in
examples/. Copy the shape, not the content. Every row_index and
table_index comes from extract.json -> revision_history; never count rows
Errors are defects: something is wrong and needs correcting.
Recommendations are improvements: nothing is wrong, but it could be
clearer or better presented. If you cannot decide, ask whether a reviewer
would be obliged to act on it - if yes it is an error.
Checks that could not be completed go in checks_not_performed, so an
empty Errors table is never mistaken for 'nothing wrong'.

revision_history_notes.text: Revision column reads 3 but the page header reads Rev. 2. One of the two is wrong.
Claimed but not done: no §9 Environmental Monitoring exists in this revision.
Missing entry: the call rate acceptance criterion in §5.2 changed from 95% to 98%.
Missing entry: the document title changed from “NIPT Assay Specification” to “NIPT Assay Validation Specification”.
Missing entry: §4.3 Equipment was renumbered to §4.4; the numbering now skips 4.3.
Missing entry: §6 now reads “The regression sample set is TBD”, replacing the reference to VER-0045 Appendix A.

errors.error: Conflicting storage requirements. §3 requires the kit at 2-8 °C; §7 requires samples at room temperature (15-25 °C). Both are written as requirements and cannot both be met for the same material. Decide which condition controls, state it once, and cross-reference it from the other section.
The revision column reads 3 but the page header reads Rev. 2. One of the two is wrong and must be corrected before approval.
The entry claims “Added Section 9 Environmental Monitoring”, but no §9 exists in this revision. Either add the section or remove the claim.
The call rate acceptance criterion changed from 95% to 98% since Rev 1 with no revision history entry. A change to an acceptance criterion must be described in the revision history.

§6 reads “The regression sample set is TBD”, replacing the reference to VER-0045 Appendix A. A released specification cannot leave a verification input undefined, and the change is not in the revision history.
ISO 13485:2003 is cited; the current edition appears to be ISO 13485:2016. Confirm against the controlled standards list.

ISO 15223-1:2016 is cited; the current edition appears to be ISO 15223-1:2021, with Amendment 1:2025 applying where the authorised-representative symbol is used. Confirm against the controlled standards list.

21 CFR Part 820 is cited as the “Quality System Regulation”. Part 820 has been the Quality Management System Regulation (QMSR) since 2 February 2026 and incorporates ISO 13485:2016 by reference. Confirm against the controlled standards list.

The page header title (“NIPT Assay Specification”) does not match the document title (“NIPT Assay Validation Specification”), and the body now covers validation content the header title does not describe.
§1 states that environmental monitoring is described in §9. There is no §9 in this revision, so the cross-reference resolves to nothing.
Heading numbering runs 4.1, 4.2, 4.4. There is no 4.3.

recommendations.recommendation: Describe changes by section number and old → new value (“§5.2 acceptance criterion 95% → 98%”) rather than in general terms. It makes each entry verifiable against the body at the next review.
DAISY and NIPT are used without expansion at first use and the document has no definitions section. Consider adding one, or expanding both at first use.
The footer carries the uncontrolled-copy statement and PAGE/NUMPAGES fields but no template ID. Adding the template ID would let template currency be checked from the document itself.
Consider adding a change-order / DCR column so each revision is traceable to the change order that authorised it without leaving the document.
Acceptance criteria would be easier to verify if the criterion, the method and the sample set were presented in one table per requirement rather than in prose.
